entry.name: RAPP Crispy
entry.summary: A local-first meeting stack. Records a meeting, removes background noise with DeepFilterNet3 (or RNNoise), transcribes it on a whisper.cpp server bound to 127.0.0.1, and writes Summary / Decisions / Action items / Open questions through a hook you own. Also puts a denoised virtual microphone in front of your meeting app. Audio, transcripts and notes are plain files under ~/.rappcrispy/meetings. Capture, denoising and transcription never leave the machine; the notes hook does whatever you point it at, and the default one calls `claude -p`, which sends the transcript to Anthropic. Denoise quality is measured, not asserted — action=bench reproduces it, including the case it handles badly.
entry.tagline: Record, denoise, transcribe and summarise meetings entirely on your own machine.
